raw_segments.text: they're saying what embodies knowledge is no proof of their actually then exercising it because they who are under the operation of these passions repeat
demonstrations or verses of Empedocles just as children when first learning string words together
But as yet know nothing of their meaning because they must grow into it and this is a process requiring time
So that we must suppose these men who fail in self-control to say these moral sayings just as actors do
